header: THE FLIGHTS TO AND FROM ANDAL AIRPORT: I show two lists, flights leaving Durgapur and flights reaching Durgapur, each flight with its time at Durgapur, the other city, the flight number, the time there and how long it flies; the next flight of each list is marked, and flights already gone for the day are dimmed. This is the airport's TIMETABLE (src/lib/live/flights.ts reads the airport's own flight page and checks it), and the card says so, says when the airport last updated it, and links the airport's own live boards. Nothing typed is sent anywhere: the request carries nothing.

doc: THE TOP OF THE TIME AND THE TOP OF THE FIRST LINE ARE ONE ROW OF PIXELS. I trim the room ABOVE a capital on both (text-box: trim-start cap alphabetic: only the top, because the title is cut with overflow hidden for its ellipsis and trimming its bottom would clip the tails of g, y and p), so the larger time does not poke above the smaller text; a browser without it falls back to aligning the baselines. Poppins' round digits (0 2 3 6 8 9) stand 0.04 to 0.045 em ABOVE its capitals, so I let the time down 0.05 em (relative top, in em: the text stays elastic). THE TITLE ALSO HAS 0.12 em OF HEADROOM (padding above it and the same negative margin): the trim puts the top of the box at capital height, and the ellipsis clip would otherwise shave the tops of b, d, h, k, l, the dot of i and the tops of f and j, which stand higher than a capital in Poppins. MEASURED on the real card (screenshots read pixel by pixel, 12 cards, widths 1160 to 2560, 100% to 200% scaling): the tops are the same row on 100% screens of common widths and within ONE physical pixel everywhere else, which is the most there is, because each text puts its baseline on a whole device pixel by itself.

behaviours: the card names the airport and its code, and says when the airport last updated its list (12 Nov, 8:20 pm), in Indian time
two lists, leaving Durgapur and reaching Durgapur, six flights in each
a departure says 'To Bengaluru (BLR)', the airline and number, when it reaches and how long it flies: 08:55, IndiGo 6E 509, reaches 11:35, 2 h 40 min
an arrival says 'From Bengaluru (BLR)', when it leaves there and how long it flies: 08:15, IndiGo 6E 508, leaves 05:45, 2 h 30 min
the next flight of each list is marked with how long to wait: at 10:00 the next departure is 12:00 (in 2 h) and the next arrival 11:25 (in 1 h 25 min)
late in the evening no departure is marked and the card says no more flights are left in that list; early in the morning the first flight of each list is next
flights already gone are dimmed
the card says plainly that it is the timetable, NOT live status (no delay, no cancellation), that the schedule can change, and to check with the airline on the day
the title has headroom above it (padding and an equal negative margin), so the ellipsis clip does not shave the tops of b, d, h, l, f and the dot of i
it links the airport's own live arrivals and departures boards and its flight page, each in a new tab with noopener
the card refreshes itself every ten minutes

the time sits at the TOP LEFT of each card and its top is the top of the first line: both have the room above a capital trimmed (text-box trim-start cap alphabetic), the larger time is let down 0.05 em for the height of Poppins' round digits, and a browser without text-box falls back to the baselines; no fixed line height (the omnibar's text stays elastic)

the first line is NOT trimmed at its bottom: it is cut with overflow hidden for its ellipsis, and a trim at the baseline would clip the tails of g, y and p ('Bengaluru' would read 'Benaaluru', 'Hyderabad' 'Hvderabad')
more room between the time and the three lines of data on the right: a gap of 1rem (gap-4) after a time column of 3.5rem, where it was 0.75rem
a flight LEAVING Durgapur shows a rough fare chip 'about ₹6,900, one way, economy' for Delhi; the arrivals show none (the listings are for Durgapur to the city)
every route has its chip, Chennai included (about ₹6,500): all six departures carry one
each fare chip has a tooltip that gives the count of listings, the range and the date and says it is not the airline's price

the card carries a disclaimer under the lists: a rough guide, not the airline's price, the sites it came from and their date, they disagree, depends on the date, higher close to the day, no fare for Chennai, check IndiGo
an out-of-date fare guide (over 45 days) shows no fare chip and says so
no days chip is drawn while no flight's days have been checked (nothing is guessed), and the card still says the page does not give the days
'andal airport flights to and from' and its like open the card
an ordinary question is not the card's: 'ltc flight booking rules' and 'air travel entitlement'
the sample questions are the card's own words
the route reads nothing from the caller: no request parameter, the airport's fixed address only
